// About

Hi, I'm Vivek. I graduated with a B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering from NIT Kurukshetra. Somewhere in the middle of studying circuits, I realized I cared a lot more about the problems on the other side of a product — the users, the data, the decisions. That curiosity pulled me from electronics into data analytics, then into product thinking, and now into AI/ML.
